verdict.rationale: Column docs confirm a card program supporting both physical and virtual cards via major networks/issuer processors, and a Column engineer corroborates issuing bank/card program status. However, evidence lacks detail on spend controls (limits, MCC restrictions) and digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning specifics. missing for 10: documented spend control APIs, digital wallet tokenization/push-provisioning support, independent hands-on confirmation of card issuance flow.
